workloads.range: Each left query selects exactly one point [idx%R,idx%R+1); output count equals left query count. Stored right has4partitions.
workloads.point: Existing all-matches equality lookup, same right/left sizes as range.
workloads.left_partition_scaling: Right65536rows/4partitions, left256queries over1/4/16/64partitions; same matched-output size.
workloads.literal: Established literal query point1 over stored rights4096/16384/65536rows; no private storage-index inspection.
workloads.scalar_direct_and_reused: A full-range scalar query returns Rmatching rows; time hl.eval(len(q)) versus hl.eval(len(if_else(len(q)>0,q,empty))). Query payload is not localized to Python. No invocation counters.

validation: 146 public Python tests passed across query/table-matrix lookup, case/switch, expression input and stream suites.
Rust conditional globals constructor test covers nonnullable branches with true/false/missing selector and nullable output schema.
Rust prefix projection test uses explicitly ordered public Arrow input with3nonempty partitions and confirms identical membership/order after packing unchanged key prefix.
Nested missing tuple/array/struct keys and bounds agree with public interval.contains for all4 inclusion combinations; original source match order is retained.
Reused query selector/result, nested conditionals, projected sibling globals, coalesce and changing text-source selectors verify scalar dependency semantics and action freshness.
limitations: Each workload runs in a fresh process with20second cap after runtime/source construction. RSS is macOS process peak including runtime/input data; timings are machine observations, not isolated operator throughput.
Final resource run occurred after builds ended; final-only left-partition/literal workloads have no baseline comparison.

Index construction scans/retains right Arrow batches once per action; canonical keys and row positions are materialized, payload buffers are retained rather than concatenated. Matched payload gathering scales with actual output size.
Increasing partition counts adds left-plan/stream overhead; measurements plus the shared physical owner contract support reuse without an invocation-counter assertion.
The query-prefix projection removes a redundant sort, but equality lookup remains dominated by its existing grouping/join path. No material equality-lookup speedup is claimed.
Literal-bound results/resource observations preserve the supported pruning path; no exact fragment-read count or private storage representation is asserted.

Selected-only captured dependencies are scheduled at the closed unindexed scalar conditional boundary. Indexed/free lexical/aggregate/RNG expressions retain their existing evaluator/cardinality/context paths; no general per-row conditional-dependency scheduler is claimed.

Index ordering uses the existing interval comparison representation, distinct from table-key order for nested missing values. Positions are stably sorted once if needed; matching ranges then restore source order using output-sized sorting (O(M log M) fallback), not a claimed universally linear output cost.

One conditional execute owns an exact-identity cache of successful atomic Aggregate/Conditional results; owning references prevent address reuse. Ordinary Map/Read captures remain logical for projection, and only needed source globals are boxed. No cache survives that action.
